display.purpose: The view's h1. One per screen.

headline.purpose: Section h2 and the login card title.

title.purpose: Program card h3 — the name of one saved rule.

body.purpose: All prose and all values. Capped at 60ch (--measure) for notes, empty states, help bubbles.

label.purpose: Field labels, table row headers, fieldset legends. Slate Muted. Never body copy.

data.purpose: Durations, percentages, timestamps, zone counts. Always tabular-nums.

shadows.name: seated
shadows.purpose: Sections, cards, login form. The default and, for in-flow content, the only one.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: The help bubble — something opened over the page.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: The toast and any future <dialog> — something above everything.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/focus state changes on tabs, buttons, help bubbles.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Gauge arc stroke-dashoffset — a value settling, not a flourish.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing. Exponential ease-out; no bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: dot-pulse
motion.purpose: Live-state dot on a running badge. Decorative — the badge text carries the state.

motion.name: reduced-motion-guard
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: .001ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: .001ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
motion.purpose: Universal and non-negotiable (WCAG 2.3.3). Must remain the LAST block in the stylesheet.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Tightens gap to --space-3 and section padding; shrinks table row-header min-width.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: --maxw 720px; tab row becomes static top nav instead of bottom bar.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: --maxw 1100px; two-column Home and Schedule list/editor split allowed.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single most-likely path on a view. One per screen.
components.css: .ds-action { font: inherit; font-size: var(--fs-13, 13px); padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-3, 12px); border-radius: var(--radius-2, 6px); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd5e0); background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--fg, #0f172a); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-action-primary { background: var(--accent, #2563eb); border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); } .ds-action-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-strong, #1f56d3); border-color: var(--accent-strong, #1f56d3); } .ds-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; } .ds-action:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-action { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Default Action
components.description: Most buttons. Neutral face; the label carries the persuasion.
components.css: .ds-action { font: inherit; font-size: var(--fs-13, 13px); padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-3, 12px); border-radius: var(--radius-2, 6px); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd5e0); background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--fg, #0f172a); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-action:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-action { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Danger Action
components.description: Delete, stop all, reboot. Serious at rest, never urgent.
components.css: .ds-action { font: inherit; font-size: var(--fs-13, 13px); padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-3, 12px); border-radius: var(--radius-2, 6px); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd5e0); background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--fg, #0f172a); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-action-danger { border-color: var(--err, #b91c1c); color: var(--err, #b91c1c); } .ds-action-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--err, #b91c1c) 16%, var(--card, #fff)); border-color: var(--err, #b91c1c); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-action { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Program Card
components.description: The signature surface. Accent-soft ground says 'this is a saved rule'. Never nested inside another card.
components.html:
Front Lawn

Enabled
RunsEvery Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 6:00 AM
ZonesFront Lawn, Side Strip — 18 min base
components.css: .ds-program { border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd5e0); border-radius: var(--radius-4, 10px); padding: var(--space-3, 12px) var(--space-4, 16px); background: var(--accent-soft, color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent, #2563eb) 8%, var(--card, #fff))); color: var(--fg, #0f172a); } .ds-program header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-3, 12px); flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-program h3 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--fs-16, 16px); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-badges { display: flex; gap: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-size: var(--fs-12, 12px); font-weight: 600; padding: 2px var(--space-2, 8px); border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd5e0); color: var(--muted, #586380); } .ds-badge-on { color: #fff; background: #15803d; border-color: #15803d; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; color: currentColor; animation: ds-dot-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-dot-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: .35; } } .ds-meta { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: var(--space-3, 12px) 0 0; } .ds-meta th { text-align: left; color: var(--muted, #586380); font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--fs-14, 14px); min-width: 6.5em; max-width: 40%; padding: var(--space-1, 4px) 0; vertical-align: top; } .ds-meta td { padding: var(--space-1, 4px) 0; font-size: var(--fs-14, 14px); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot { animation-duration: .001ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Transparent face inherits whatever ground it sits on; correct in both schemes for free. 16px so iOS never zooms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-1, 4px); } .ds-field label { font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--fs-14, 14px); color: var(--muted, #586380); } .ds-field input { padding: 9px; font-size: var(--fs-16, 16px); border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd5e0); border-radius: var(--radius-1, 4px); background: transparent; color: inherit; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); }

components.name: Tab Navigation
components.description: Active state is text weight + underline shape + color — three signals, never color alone. Icons supplement; labels always visible.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active">Home</button><button class="ds-tab">Schedule</button><button class="ds-tab">Zones</button><button class="ds-tab">Weather</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd5e0); flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-tab { padding: 9px 16px; border: none; background: none; color: var(--muted, #586380); cursor: pointer; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; font: inherit; font-size: var(--fs-15, 15px); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 40px; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--fg, #0f172a); } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--fg, #0f172a); font-weight: 600; border-bottom-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-tab { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Help Tip
components.description: The pattern for every 'why?' in the product. Opens on hover, focus, AND tap; a 13px glyph carries an invisible 44px hit area.
components.html: ?Weather lowered today's run to 45%. A 10 minute zone runs about 4½ minutes.
components.css: .ds-help { position: relative; display: inline-block; color: var(--accent, #2563eb); cursor: help; font-size: var(--fs-13, 13px); font-weight: 600; } .ds-help::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 50% auto auto 50%; width: 44px; height: 44px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); } .ds-help-bubble { display: none; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 150%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: max-content; max-width: 240px; padding: 6px 9px; z-index: 10; background: var(--fg, #0f172a); color: var(--bg, #f6f7fb); border-radius: var(--radius-2, 6px); font-size: var(--fs-12, 12px); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.35; text-align: left; white-space: normal; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(15,23,42,.10); } .ds-help:hover .ds-help-bubble, .ds-help:focus-visible .ds-help-bubble { display: block; } .ds-help:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Error Card
components.description: States scope, never leaks a hash, token, key, or full query URL.
components.html:
Weather service unavailable
Last successful update 2 hours ago. The controller will use its fail-safe behavior.
components.css: .ds-error { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--err, #b91c1c) 10%, var(--card, #fff)); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--err, #b91c1c) 45%, var(--border, #cdd5e0)); border-radius: var(--radius-4, 10px); padding: var(--space-4, 16px) var(--space-5, 20px); color: var(--fg, #0f172a); } .ds-error-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-2, 8px); font-weight: 600; color: var(--err, #b91c1c); } .ds-error-detail { color: var(--muted, #586380); font-size: var(--fs-14, 14px); white-space: pre-wrap; margin: var(--space-2, 8px) 0 var(--space-3, 12px); max-width: 60ch; } .ds-action { font: inherit; font-size: var(--fs-13, 13px); padding: var(--space-2, 8px) var(--space-3, 12px); border-radius: var(--radius-2, 6px); cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--border, #cdd5e0); background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--fg, #0f172a); min-height: 36px; } .ds-action:hover { border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Confirmation of a verified result. Never the sole location of an error.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; background: var(--fg, #0f172a); color: var(--bg, #f6f7fb); padding: var(--space-3, 12px) var(--space-4, 16px); border-radius: var(--radius-3, 8px); font-size: var(--fs-14, 14px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.18); max-width: min(90vw, 640px); }

narrative.overview:
This is a well-made household instrument, not an app experience. It lives on a phone held at arm's length in direct sunlight next to an open valve box, and it lives in a desktop tab during a seasonal schedule rework. Both times its job is identical: report what is true, and never look like it is performing. The system is a native-font, framework-free, single-stylesheet panel where a border does the work a shadow would do elsewhere and a word does the work an icon would do elsewhere.

Every visual decision descends from one constraint and one duty. The constraint: the bundle is served off the controller's own LAN flash, so there is no web font, no raster asset, no off-origin request, and no icon package — graphics are inline currentColor SVG or they do not exist. The duty: the panel must never look more certain than it is. Stale data, estimated runs, and skipped weather all get visible, textual treatment, because a confident-looking screen that is lying is the worst outcome this product can produce.

It explicitly rejects the four things named in PRODUCT.md. It is not the legacy jQuery Mobile app — no gradient chrome, no blue toolbar, no chevron list rows. It is not a firmware/engineer dashboard — no hex, no packed flags, no diagnostic table as the front door. It is not a Rachio/Rain Bird consumer app — no mascot, no illustration, no marketing surface inside the product. It is not generic SaaS — no repeated icon+heading+text card grid, no hero metric tile, no gradient accent anywhere.
keyCharacteristics: Native system font stack; zero downloaded fonts, zero icon fonts.
One accent, used rarely: active tab, focus ring, primary button, gauge fill.
Bordered flat surfaces; shadows only for things that genuinely overlay.
Tabular numerals on every duration, percentage, and timestamp.
Light and dark ship together; neither is an inversion of the other.
44px targets on coarse pointers; visible focus on everything that resets its own chrome.
Motion is functional and globally revocable under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Clear-Sky Blue is the only accent and appears on well under 10% of any screen. If two things on a screen are blue, one of them is wrong. There is no secondary accent, and adding one is prohibited.

rules.name: The Sunlight Floor Rule
rules.body: Body text is Ink, never Slate Muted. This panel is read outdoors; PRODUCT.md sets outdoor sunlight readability above the AA minimum. Muted-gray body copy on a tinted near-white is a bug in this project, not a style. Slate Muted is for labels the eye skips, never for the answer the user came for.

rules.name: The Meaning-Bearing Mark Rule
rules.body: Any color that carries meaning — running, skipped, stale, fault — is accompanied by text or shape and holds ≥3:1 against its surface. Color alone is never the signal, in either scheme.

rules.name: The Derived Variant Rule
rules.body: Accent variants are produced with color-mix off --accent, never hardcoded. Dark mode redefines one token and the whole tonal family follows. Hand-picking a dark-mode accent tint is prohibited.

rules.name: The Tabular Numeral Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change while the user watches — remaining time, water level, log times, zone durations — is font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Digits must not reflow the row on a poll tick.

rules.name: The Firmware Vocabulary Ban
rules.body: fwv, fwm, fwf, uwt, wl, wto, pid, sid, OTF, and rawData never appear in rendered type outside Settings → System. This is a typographic rule because it is enforced at the moment copy is written, not at review.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above sections, and no 01 / 02 / 03 section numbering. The stepper's own step count is the sole exception — it is a real sequence carrying real information.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Rule
rules.body: --shadow-2 and --shadow-3 are reserved for elements that literally cover other content. Applying them to a card, a row, or a button to signal importance is forbidden.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: When a surface needs separating from its neighbor, add a Hairline border. Do not reach for a shadow, and do not reach for a second background tint.

rules.name: The 2014 Test
rules.body: If a surface looks lifted from the page at rest, the shadow is too dark and the blur is too small. Seated means you have to look for it.

dos: Do put body text in Ink (#0f172a / #e6eaff). Slate Muted is for labels only. The panel is read in direct sunlight — clear PRODUCT.md's outdoor readability bar, not just AA's 4.5:1.
Do compose from the existing tokens. Add a token only when it appears in at least two shipped components (UX-SPEC §14); otherwise compose.
Do derive accent variants with color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent) …) so dark mode inherits from one redefinition.
Do hardcode meaning-bearing badge fills (#15803d, #6b7280, #b91c1c) with white text. Theme-immunity beats token purity for marks that carry state.
Do use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every duration, percentage, and timestamp.
Do use native <input type="time">, <input type="date">, checkboxes, selects, and <dialog>. No picker library, no modal library.
Do keep every graphic inline currentColor SVG.
Do give visible focus (outline: 2px solid var(--accent)) to anything that resets its own border or background.
Do hit 44px under (pointer: coarse) — with an invisible ::after hit area when the visible mark must stay small.
Do keep the reduced-motion guard the last block in the stylesheet, and keep it universal.
Do cap prose at --measure (60ch) on info notes, empty states, and help bubbles.
Do wrap only the table in .table-scroll, never the section — section padding and help bubbles must never be clipped.
Do state consequence in the label: "Run Front Lawn now? Valves may open for about 18 minutes."
donts: Don't ship anything that resembles the legacy jQuery Mobile app: no gradient chrome, no blue toolbar, no chevron list rows, no 2013 mobile-web texture.

Don't ship a firmware/engineer dashboard: no hex, no packed flags, no raw object dump, no dense diagnostic table as a default screen. Diagnostics lives at Settings → System → Diagnostics and never returns to top-level nav.
Don't ship a Rachio / Rain Bird consumer app: no mascot, no playful blob, no illustration, no marketing copy or upsell inside the product.
Don't ship generic SaaS card grids: no repeated icon+heading+text cards, no hero metric tile, no gradient accent.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), glassmorphism, or any decorative blur. This panel has none and gets none.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on a card, row, or callout. Full Hairline borders or --accent-soft ground.
Don't nest a card inside a card.
Don't introduce a second accent, a new palette, a logo, a downloaded font, or a raster asset. UX-SPEC §14: no rebrand.
Don't add a warning color. Text and icon labels carry warning; --err is for actual failure and danger only.
Don't use --shadow-2/--shadow-3 on anything that isn't literally overlaying other content.
Don't make color the only signal for running, skipped, stale, or error.
Don't make hover the only path to an action, and don't ship swipe-to-delete, long-press-only, or drag-only reorder.
Don't let the pulse (or any animation) be the sole carrier of state — adjacent text always says it.
Don't drop input font-size below 16px; iOS will zoom the viewport on focus.
Don't replace a good snapshot with a full-screen spinner during a refresh.
Don't put a firmware token (fwv, wl, uwt, pid, sid, OTF, rawData) in rendered copy outside Settings → System.
Don't add an off-origin font, image, or script request. The bundle is served from controller flash on a LAN with no internet.
